name: rebot_b601_dm_residual_env_v0
notes_equality: finger_right = -finger_left via MJCF equality polycoef (matches joint_map_kinematic.yaml scale -1). Controlled list excludes finger_right like OpenArm excluded finger2.
notes_action_unit: M0 smoke: physical joint units matching MJCF. Arm dims in rad; gripper (finger_left) in meters. NEVER silently mix with LeRobot degree-space actions — unnormalize via MEAN_STD only after locking stats_id. Until then stats_id=pending_rebot_b601_dm / stats_source=none.
notes_lerobot_gripper: Seeed LeRobot B601 follower often exposes joint/gripper in degrees (or normalized). MJCF digital-twin gripper is meters (finger_left slide 0..0.05). Web console sometimes shows 0..0.09 m opening width. Mapping deg↔m is REQUIRED before wiring real MEAN_STD / FakeBase from LeRobot demos; do not invent a scale here — measure from calibration / firmware (HardwareManager) when locking stats.
notes_finger_bound: finger_bound_m=0.05 is residual δ bound in meters (gripper_unit=m); matches MJCF finger_left ctrlrange [0, 0.05]. Arm clip_c is radians — do not apply finger_bound_m to arm dims.
notes_control_hz: Residual control step locked at 20 Hz (same as OpenArm residual gate). Real-robot / ROS bringup often 100 Hz — that is NOT this gate's control_hz. Residual δ applies only at control steps (n_substeps = 1/(control_hz*sim_dt) mj_steps). Do not silently mix 100 Hz docs into residual PPO step size.
notes_qpos: model nq=29 = 3 freejoint objects (7 each) + joint1..6 + finger_left + finger_right. Actor obs q/qdot use contract joint_names only (7 DoF). Actuators nu=7 match 1:1. finger_right equality-coupled.
notes_cube: Prefer official STL scene red_cube (freejoint box size 0.025); also blue_block + yellow_cylinder present. Do not invent a second cube.
notes_scene: LOCAL overlay under sim/rebot_b601/: STL content + meshdir retarget + position actuators ×7 + finger equality + home keyframe. Vendor XML untouched (upstream nu=0).

cameras.name: overhead
cameras.notes: EXACT copy from official rebotarm_b601_stl.xml overhead_rgb. NOT OpenArm head. Render target 640x480 (official has no resolution attr).

cameras.name: wrist
cameras.notes: LeRobot key frozen as observation.images.wrist. Official MJCF has NO wrist camera (hardware D405 mount only). Extrinsics NOT invented — MJCF wrist pending / self-build. Gate may run without wrist render.

notes_camera: camera_in_env=true: overhead from official overhead_rgb; wrist key reserved but MJCF pending (do NOT invent extrinsics). LeRobot keys frozen: observation.images.wrist + observation.images.overhead. Never call overhead 'head'. camera_in_actor_obs=false. Extrinsics (overhead only) enter obs_keys_hash digest; wrist nulls hash as pending.
extrinsics_notes: overhead = official. wrist = not invented. Aligns with docs/ReBot_B601_DM_Survey.md.
notes_reward_success: reward_version=v0_sparse_success_plus_delta_l2: r=-λ‖δ‖² + 1{success_just_now}·R_term. NO w_z·cube_z shaping. success=(cube_z>=z_lift_abs)&(held_steps>=H); privilege only in reward/info, NEVER Actor obs. Geometry: table_top_z=task_table.z+half=0.015+0.015=0.03; cube_rest_z=red_cube pos z=0.055 (half=0.025); z_lift_abs=cube_rest_z+z_lift_rel=0.055+0.08=0.135. Changing z_lift_abs/H/λ/R_term MUST bump reward_version. VLA demo success labels MUST reuse the SAME z_lift_abs+H from this contract.
notes_failure_mode: failure_mode ∈ {none,timeout,drop,unsafe}. timeout=truncated by t_max; drop=ever_lift then cube_z<(cube_rest_z+drop_margin) before success; unsafe=NaN in q/qdot/ctrl or q outside joint hard range (minimal); else none while running/on success.
